content.json:
# 🎯 SigninLogs Threat Hunting Workbook

**Purpose:** Advanced threat hunting and anomaly detection for Azure AD/Entra ID sign-in activities.

| Capability | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| 🔴 Brute Force Detection | Identify accounts under credential attack |
| 🟠 Password Spray Detection | Detect distributed password guessing |
| 🟡 Anomaly Detection | Unusual patterns, times, locations |
| 🌍 Geolocation Analysis | Impossible travel and geographic threats |
| 📊 Risk Analysis | Correlate with Identity Protection signals |

parameters.name: BaselineDays
parameters.label: Baseline Period (Days)
parameters.description: Lookback window for first-seen / new-country / new-IP logic.

parameters.name: BaselineOffsetDays
parameters.label: Baseline Offset (Days)
parameters.description: Days to skip between the baseline window and now.

parameters.name: ExcludedIPs
parameters.label: Excluded IPs / CIDR / Ranges
parameters.description: Comma-separated trusted IPs / CIDR / IPv4 ranges. Empty = no IP filter.

parameters.name: NamedLocations
parameters.label: Named Locations (Exclude)
parameters.description: Entra ID Conditional Access Named Locations seen on sign-ins. Multi-select to exclude.
parameters.query:
SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(NetworkLocationDetails)
| project NLD = tostring(NetworkLocationDetails)
| where NLD has 'networkNames'
| summarize by NLD
| take 5000
| extend arr = todynamic(NLD)
| mv-expand entry = arr
| mv-expand name = entry.networkNames
| extend NamedLocation = tostring(name)
| where isnotempty(NamedLocation)
| distinct NamedLocation
| order by NamedLocation asc

content.json:
## 🧩 Baseline & Exclusions filters

---

Use the pills above to tune every tile in this workbook without editing any KQL.

| Filter | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Time Range** | Window applied to all queries via `{TimeRange}`. | Last 7 days |
| **Failure Threshold** | Minimum failed-sign-in count for brute-force / spray heuristics. | `10` |
| **Baseline Period (Days)** | Lookback used by *first-seen* / *new-country* / *new-IP* logic. Larger = stricter. | `30` |
| **Baseline Offset (Days)** | Days to skip between the baseline window and *now*. Prevents the current event from contaminating its own baseline. | `1` |
| **Excluded IPs / CIDR / Ranges** | Trusted IPs removed from every tile via `ipv4_is_in_any_range()`. Comma-separated. Single IPv4, CIDR (`10.0.0.0/8`) or range (`10.0.0.1-10.0.0.255`). Empty = no IP filter. | *(empty)* |
| **Named Locations (Exclude)** | Conditional Access *Named Locations* observed on sign-ins (`NetworkLocationDetails.networkNames`). Multi-select to drop matching rows. Empty = no location filter. | *(empty)* |

> **How exclusions are applied** — every query is wrapped with a parameter-driven prelude that *shadows* `SigninLogs` with a filtered version, so downstream KQL is unchanged. No watchlist required.

> **Note on Named Locations** — workbooks cannot read Conditional Access Named Locations directly from Microsoft Graph. The dropdown lists only locations that have **been stamped on a sign-in event** in the last 30 days. A trusted location nobody signs in from will not appear, but it also produces no events to filter — so functionally the filter still does its job.

---

content.json:
### 📈 7-Day Baseline Comparison
---
Compare current sign-in activity against the baseline from the previous 7 days to detect anomalies and deviations.

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('[\"', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '\",\"'), '\"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// 7-Day Baseline Deviation Analysis
let CurrentWeek = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize 
    CurrentTotal = count(),
    CurrentSuccess = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    CurrentFailed = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    CurrentUniqueUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d);
let PreviousWeek = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(7d))
| summarize 
    BaselineTotal = count(),
    BaselineSuccess = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    BaselineFailed = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    BaselineUniqueUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName);
let BaselineAvg = toscalar(PreviousWeek | project BaselineTotal) / 7;
let BaselineFailedAvg = toscalar(PreviousWeek | project BaselineFailed) / 7;
CurrentWeek
| extend BaselineAvgDaily = BaselineAvg
| extend BaselineFailedDaily = BaselineFailedAvg
| extend TotalDeviation = round((todouble(CurrentTotal) - BaselineAvgDaily) / BaselineAvgDaily * 100, 2)
| extend FailedDeviation = round((todouble(CurrentFailed) - BaselineFailedDaily) / BaselineFailedDaily * 100, 2)
| extend DeviationIndicator = case(
    TotalDeviation > 50, "🔴 High Increase",
    TotalDeviation > 20, "🟠 Moderate Increase",
    TotalDeviation < -50, "🔵 Significant Decrease",
    TotalDeviation < -20, "🟡 Moderate Decrease",
    "🟢 Normal"
)
| extend FailedIndicator = case(
    FailedDeviation > 100, "🔴 Critical - Failures Spiked",
    FailedDeviation > 50, "🟠 High - More Failures",
    FailedDeviation > 20, "🟡 Elevated Failures",
    "🟢 Normal"
)
| project Day = format_datetime(TimeGenerated, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), CurrentTotal, BaselineAvgDaily = round(BaselineAvgDaily, 0), TotalDeviation, DeviationIndicator, CurrentFailed, BaselineFailedDaily = round(BaselineFailedDaily, 0), FailedDeviation, FailedIndicator
| order by Day desc
content.title: 📊 Daily Sign-In Baseline Deviation (Current vs Previous 7 Days)
📈 Current Week vs Baseline Trend
🔴 Failed Sign-Ins: Current vs Baseline

content.json:
## 🔴 Brute Force Attack Detection

Identify accounts experiencing high volumes of failed login attempts from single or multiple IPs, indicating potential credential attacks.

content.title: 🎯 Users Under Brute Force Attack
⚠️ Potential Compromises: Success After Failed Attempts

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// Attack Source IPs
let TrustedCountryList = dynamic(["United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "France", "Netherlands", "Australia"]);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType != "0"
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend IsPrivateIP = ipv4_is_private(IPAddress)
| extend IsAzureIP = ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "20.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "40.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "52.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "13.0.0.0/8")
| extend IsTrustedCountry = Country in (TrustedCountryList)
| extend IsTrustedLocation = IsPrivateIP or IsAzureIP or IsTrustedCountry
| extend TrustStatus = case(
    IsPrivateIP == true, "✅ Private IP",
    IsAzureIP == true, "✅ Azure IP",
    IsTrustedCountry == true, "✅ Trusted Country",
    "❌ Untrusted"
)
| summarize 
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    TargetedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    UserList = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
    Countries = make_set(Country, 3)
  by IPAddress, TrustStatus, IsTrustedLocation
| extend ThreatScore = FailedAttempts * TargetedUsers
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    IsTrustedLocation == false and ThreatScore > 100, "🔴 Critical - Untrusted High Volume",
    IsTrustedLocation == false, "🟠 High - Untrusted Source",
    ThreatScore > 500, "🟡 Elevated - High Volume",
    "🟢 Normal"
)
| where FailedAttempts >= toint({FailureThreshold})
| order by IsTrustedLocation asc, ThreatScore desc
| take 20

📈 Failed Login Attempts Timeline

content.json:
## 🌍 Geolocation & Impossible Travel Detection

Identify suspicious geographic patterns including impossible travel, unusual countries, and location anomalies.

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// Impossible Travel Detection
let maxTravelSpeed = 800; // km/h reasonable for commercial flights
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend Lat = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.latitude)
| extend Lon = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.longitude)
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| where isnotempty(Lat) and isnotempty(Lon)
| order by UserPrincipalName, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend PrevLat = prev(Lat), PrevLon = prev(Lon), PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName), PrevCountry = prev(Country)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser
| extend TimeDiffHours = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, PrevTime) / 60.0
| where TimeDiffHours > 0
| extend DistanceKm = geo_distance_2points(Lon, Lat, PrevLon, PrevLat) / 1000
| extend SpeedKmH = DistanceKm / TimeDiffHours
| where SpeedKmH > maxTravelSpeed and DistanceKm > 500
| extend ImpossibleTravel = "🔴 IMPOSSIBLE TRAVEL DETECTED"
| project 
    ImpossibleTravel,
    UserPrincipalName, 
    FromCountry = PrevCountry,
    ToCountry = Country,
    DistanceKm = round(DistanceKm, 0),
    TimeDiffMinutes = round(TimeDiffHours * 60, 0),
    SpeedKmH = round(SpeedKmH, 0),
    FromTime = PrevTime,
    ToTime = TimeGenerated,
    IPAddress
| order by SpeedKmH desc
content.title: ✈️ Impossible Travel Detection
🌐 High-Risk Countries (>50% Failure Rate)
👤 Users with Multi-Country Sign-ins

let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';

// Geographic Distribution Table
let TrustedCountryList = dynamic(["United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "France", "Netherlands", "Australia"]);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| extend IsPrivateIP = ipv4_is_private(IPAddress)
| extend IsAzureIP = ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "20.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "40.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "52.0.0.0/8")
| extend IsTrustedCountry = Country in (TrustedCountryList)
| extend IsTrustedLocation = IsPrivateIP or IsAzureIP or IsTrustedCountry
| extend TrustStatus = case(
    IsPrivateIP == true, "✅ Private",
    IsAzureIP == true, "✅ Azure",
    IsTrustedCountry == true, "✅ Trusted",
    "❌ Untrusted"
)

    FailedSignIns = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    UniqueUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName)

| extend RiskScore = case(
    IsTrustedLocation == false and FailedSignIns > 0, "🔴 Untrusted with Failures",
    IsTrustedLocation == false, "🟠 Untrusted Location",
    FailureRate > 50, "🟡 High Failure Rate",
    "🟢 Normal"
)
| order by IsTrustedLocation asc, TotalSignIns desc

content.json:
### 🔐 Trusted vs Untrusted Location Analysis
---
Compare sign-in activity from trusted locations (Private IPs, Azure IPs, Trusted Countries) against untrusted sources.

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// Trusted vs Untrusted Location Summary
let TrustedCountryList = dynamic(["United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "France", "Netherlands", "Australia"]);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend IsPrivateIP = ipv4_is_private(IPAddress)
| extend IsAzureIP = ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "20.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "40.0.0.0/8") or ipv4_is_in_range(IPAddress, "52.0.0.0/8")
| extend IsTrustedCountry = Country in (TrustedCountryList)
| extend IsTrustedLocation = IsPrivateIP or IsAzureIP or IsTrustedCountry
| extend TrustCategory = case(
    IsPrivateIP == true, "Private IP",
    IsAzureIP == true, "Azure IP",
    IsTrustedCountry == true, "Trusted Country",
    "Untrusted"
)
| summarize 
    Total = count(),
    Success = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    Failed = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    UniqueUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(IPAddress)
    by TrustCategory
| extend FailureRate = round(todouble(Failed) / Total * 100, 2)
| extend RiskIndicator = case(
    TrustCategory == "Untrusted" and Failed > 0, "🔴 High Risk",
    TrustCategory == "Untrusted", "🟠 Monitor",
    FailureRate > 20, "🟡 Elevated Failures",
    "🟢 Normal"
)
| order by TrustCategory
content.title: 📊 Sign-Ins by Trust Category
🥧 Trust Category Distribution

## 🔍 Anomaly Detection

Identify unusual patterns including off-hours activity, new devices, legacy protocols, and behavioral anomalies.

content.title: 🌙 Off-Hours & Weekend Activity
📟 Legacy Authentication Usage (Security Risk)

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('[\"', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '\",\"'), '\"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// New Device First Seen
let knownDevices = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated < ago(7d) and TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| distinct UserPrincipalName, DeviceId;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "0"
| extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
| extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName)
| extend DeviceOS = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| extend Browser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser)
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| join kind=leftanti knownDevices on UserPrincipalName, DeviceId
| summarize 
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    SignInCount = count(),
    Countries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 3)
  by UserPrincipalName, DeviceId, DeviceName, DeviceOS, Browser
| extend Alert = "🆕 NEW DEVICE"
| order by FirstSeen desc
| take 30
content.title: 🆕 New Devices (First Seen in Selected Range)
🤖 Suspicious User Agents
📱 Users Accessing New Applications

## ⚠️ Risk Analysis & Identity Protection

Correlate sign-in data with Azure AD Identity Protection risk signals.

content.title: 📊 Risk Summary
👤 High Risk Users
📈 Risk Events by Type
📊 Risk Level Trend Over Time
🛡️ Conditional Access Blocks

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// Top Risky Users from Identity Protection
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RiskLevelAggregated in ("high", "medium") or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| summarize 
    RiskySignIns = count(),
    HighRiskSignIns = countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "high"),
    MediumRiskSignIns = countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "medium"),
    SuccessfulRisky = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    FailedRisky = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    RiskEvents = make_set(RiskEventTypes_V2, 10),
    Countries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 5),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
    LastRiskySignIn = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName, RiskLevelAggregated
| extend UserRiskScore = (HighRiskSignIns * 10) + (MediumRiskSignIns * 5) + (SuccessfulRisky * 20)
| extend ThreatLevel = case(
    SuccessfulRisky > 0 and HighRiskSignIns > 0, "🔴 Critical - High Risk with Success",
    RiskLevelAggregated == "high", "🟠 High Risk User",
    RiskLevelAggregated == "medium", "🟡 Medium Risk User",
    "🟢 Low"
)
| project ThreatLevel, UserPrincipalName, RiskLevelAggregated, UserRiskScore, HighRiskSignIns, MediumRiskSignIns, SuccessfulRisky, FailedRisky, RiskEvents, Countries, IPs, LastRiskySignIn
| order by UserRiskScore desc
| take 30

Correlate sign-in IPs against active indicators in the `ThreatIntelIndicators` table (STIX 2.1 schema). Matches indicate authentication activity from infrastructure already catalogued as malicious.

content.query:
// Active Threat Intelligence Indicators Summary (STIX 2.1)
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsActive == true and Revoked == false
| extend ObservableType = tostring(split(ObservableKey, ":")[0])
| summarize 
    ActiveIndicators = dcount(Id),
    Sources = dcount(SourceSystem),
    AvgConfidence = round(avg(todouble(Confidence)), 1),

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),

    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))

// Sign-ins from IPs Matching Active TI Indicators (STIX 2.1)
let MaliciousIPs = ThreatIntelIndicators
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where IsActive == true and Revoked == false
    | where ObservableKey =~ "ipv4-addr:value"
    | where todouble(Confidence) >= 50
    | extend MaliciousIP = tostring(ObservableValue)
    | extend ThreatType = tostring(column_ifexists("ThreatType",""))
    | where isnotempty(MaliciousIP)
    | summarize 
        ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType, 5),
        TISources = make_set(SourceSystem, 5),
        MaxConfidence = max(todouble(Confidence)),
        LastReported = max(TimeGenerated)
      by MaliciousIP;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| join kind=inner MaliciousIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.MaliciousIP
| summarize 
    SignInAttempts = count(),
    SuccessfulSignIns = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    FailedSignIns = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    TargetedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    UserList = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 10),
    Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),

)
| project ThreatLevel, IPAddress, ThreatTypes, MaxConfidence, TISources, SignInAttempts, SuccessfulSignIns, FailedSignIns, TargetedUsers, UserList, Apps, Countries, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| order by SuccessfulSignIns desc, SignInAttempts desc

## 🤖 Botnet Detection (Behavioral)

Pure-behavior heuristics that flag distributed / automated sign-in activity **without** relying on Threat Intelligence feeds. Useful when ThreatIntelIndicators is empty or stale.

| Signal | Heuristic |
|---|---|
| **Distributed users** | One UPN targeted by many distinct IPs across multiple countries |
| **Shared UA fanout** | Same User-Agent string seen across an unusually large number of IPs |
| **Low-and-slow** | Many IPs each making only 1–3 failed attempts against the same user |
| **Automated UAs** | Headless / scripted clients (curl, python, Go-http-client, okhttp, …) |
| **Timeline** | Spikes in *distinct attacking IPs per hour* (volumetric botnet bursts) |

> All tiles honour **Time Range**, **Excluded IPs** and **Named Locations** filters.

content.query:
let _ExcIPs_raw = '{ExcludedIPs}';
let _ExcIPs = iif(_ExcIPs_raw == '', dynamic([]),
    todynamic(strcat('["', replace_string(replace_string(_ExcIPs_raw, ' ', ''), ',', '","'), '"]')));
let _NLSel = dynamic([{NamedLocations}]);
let _NLActive = array_length(_NLSel) > 0;
let SigninLogs = SigninLogs
    | where _ExcIPs_raw == '' or isempty(IPAddress) or not(ipv4_is_in_any_range(IPAddress, _ExcIPs))
    | where not(_NLActive) or isempty(NetworkLocationDetails) or not(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any (_NLSel));
// Distributed Attack: users targeted by many distinct IPs across multiple countries
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType != "0"
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| summarize
    DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress),
    DistinctCountries = dcount(Country),
    DistinctASNs = dcount(tostring(parse_json(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails))[0].networkNames)),
    FailedAttempts = count(),
    SuccessfulSignIns = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    IPSample = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
    CountrySample = make_set(Country, 10),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserPrincipalName
| where DistinctIPs >= 10 and DistinctCountries >= 3
| extend BotnetLikelihood = case(
    DistinctIPs >= 100 or DistinctCountries >= 10, "🔴 Critical - Highly Distributed",
    DistinctIPs >= 30 or DistinctCountries >= 5, "🟠 High - Distributed Attack",
    "🟡 Suspicious - Multi-Source")
| project BotnetLikelihood, UserPrincipalName, DistinctIPs, DistinctCountries, FailedAttempts, SuccessfulSignIns, IPSample, CountrySample, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| order by DistinctIPs desc
